---
applyTo: "features/**/*.feature"
---

# Cucumber Hebrew Feature Files

- Always start with `# language: he`
- Use Hebrew keywords only: `תכונה`, `תרחיש`, `תרחיש לדוגמה`, `בהינתן`, `וכאשר`, `אז`, `ו-`
- Scenario titles must be descriptive in Hebrew
- Each scenario must test exactly one behaviour
- Use `רקע:` for Background blocks
